# Agent CRM

> Agentic CRM landing: revenue agents that build pipeline, advance deals, and grow accounts around the clock so the CRM does not sit idle overnight.

- Site: https://agent-crm.lizliz.xyz/
- Maker: Liz (https://lizliz.xyz/)
- Category: BusinessApplication / agentic CRM (design study inspired by Attio)
- Stack shown: Next.js static marketing shell; SDK / API / MCP called out on-page
- Integrations shown: Claude, Slack, Clay, Linear, Notion, Gmail, Granola, Stripe, Zapier; imports from Salesforce, HubSpot, Pipedrive

## What it is not

- Not a verified multi-tenant production CRM with published pricing
- Not a Chinese-localized product (English-only; no hreflang)
- Not an Attio affiliate or official Attio property — design study attribution only
